membership_invitations_lifecycle_check.name: membership_invitations_lifecycle_check
membership_invitations_lifecycle_check.value: ("membership_invitations"."status" <> 'accepted' OR ("membership_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "membership_invitations"."accepted_by_clerk_user_id" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("membership_invitations"."status" <> 'revoked' OR "membership_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

spaces_event_dates_check.name: spaces_event_dates_check
